name: Data Algorithms & Text Tools
description: Provides text search/replace, regex processing, JSON query, list/map operations, random number generators, math evaluation, and hash digest tools.

AccessArray.description: Retrieve, modify, or extract items from an array by index.

AccessKey.description: Query JSON or dictionary content by key name.

ArraySize.description: Calculate the number of elements in an array, list, or JSON tuple.

ArrayOperations.description: Sort, reverse, deduplicate, filter empty, flatten, slice, or push/pop elements in arrays.

JsonQuery.description: Extract nested JSON data using dot-notation, wildcard (*), and array slice expressions.

SubString.description: Extract a slice of text specified by start position and length.

SplitString.description: Split text into a tuple list using a delimiter.

JoinString.description: Join array items into a single string using a delimiter.

RegexProcess.description: Match, extract, or replace text using regular expressions.

TextTransform.description: Trim, convert case, or perform Base64 and URL encoding/decoding.

RandomNumber.description: Generate a random integer or float within a specified range.

MathEval.description: Perform arithmetic operations, sum, average, min, max, or rounding on numbers.

DateTimeHelper.description: Get current timestamp (sec/ms/us), ISO-8601 strings, formatted date strings, or calculate time offsets.

RandomPoint.description: Generate randomized coordinate points with jitter to humanize clicks.

RectOperations.description: Calculate rectangle center, polygon point-in-polygon test, bounding box, offset, or bounds expansion.

GridGenerator.description: Generate row/column coordinate grids for multi-cell batch clicks.

HashDigest.description: Compute MD5 or SHA256 hashes for strings or text data.

FileHash.description: Stream and compute MD5 or SHA256 checksums for files without memory overflow.

CreateObject.description: Instantiate structured data objects in memory (Point, Rect, Size, Color, Range, DateTime, etc.)
